main_text.head: PRÆFATIO.
main_text.p: men ut in communi incendio si quis quantumuis abiecta fortuna sitellam aquæ deferat, studium credo eius nemo repudiet: ita spero neminem patriæ communis amantem meam hanc in quærendis remediis operam aspernaAnno 1572. & 1573.turum. Superioribus quidem mentibus in tantarum calamitatum cogitatione defixus, veteres Francogalliæ nostræ historicos & Gallos & Ger-manos euolui: summamque ex eorum scriptis confeci eius status, quem an-nos amplius mille in Republica no-stra viguisse testantur: ex qua incre-dibile dictu est quantam maiorum no-strorum in constituenda Republica nostra sapientiam cognoscere liceat. ut mihi quidem nequaquam dubium esse videatur, quin ab illa certissimum tantorum malorum remedium peteн-dum sit. Nam mihi attentius in ista-rum

page.notes: The marginal note reads "Anno 1572. & 1573." and is set beside the line "naturum." The printed word is "asper-" broken as "asper-naturum"; the hyphen at the line end is kept as printed. The text is cut off at the bottom of this part. Line "petendum" is partly damaged at the start ("dum sit" partly illegible); the final word "rum" stands alone at the right end of the last line. Some letters in "petendum" are uncertain and are marked for checking.
